Sell Feet Pics as a Guy

Guys are allowed on the feet marketplaces that bother to say so. What nobody honest can hand you is a male-only average, because the shops do not publish one.

Dark-Ero editorialUpdated 2026-11-1018+

At a glance

FeetFinder says adults 18 and over can sell regardless of gender, and it keeps a Male category.

Basic keeps 85 percent of a sale and Premium keeps 90 percent, with no separate male price.

Any post that promises men a fixed monthly income is guessing.

Key takeaways

  • You upload a government ID and a selfie holding it, the same as every other seller.
  • Buyers can filter by gender, which only makes sense if some of them are looking for men.
  • Face-out files are optional, and the ID still sits with the platform.
  • The Bureau of Labor Statistics figure for models is a different job from selling files online.
  • Count completed sales, and give a Basic plan a few quiet months before you judge it.

Yes, guys can sell feet pics. FeetFinder says anyone 18 or older can buy or sell regardless of gender, and a July 2026 FAQ answer calls male feet an established niche with its own category and a real buyer base.

The longer version, including the labor-statistics detour, is sell feet pics as a guy. The useful part is the fee, which does not change because you are a man.

Men are allowed

Buyers can filter sellers by gender, along with age and other details. That makes a men's profile easy to find for the buyers who want it, and easy to skip for the ones who do not.

Every seller uploads a government ID and a selfie holding that ID before they can sell. There is no second, cheaper door for men, and there is no extra toll either.

You do not have to show your face. Other users see the username, the photos, the bio, ethnicity and foot size, while the ID and the address stay on the verification and payout side.

Say that the sets are male feet in the first line of the bio. Wording for that line is in our FeetFinder bio ideas piece.

What a guy can keep

Basic is $4.99 a month and you keep 85 percent of each sale. Premium is $14.99 a month and you keep 90 percent, and Premium only pulls ahead once sales are large enough to cover the dearer plan.

FeetFinder has said it does not publish a male-only median, an average male sale price, or a male conversion rate. Treat a guide that promises men up to $4,000 a month as a guess wearing a number.

The first months can be zero sales, which is also true for women. Budget the plan as a cost you can lose, then judge the shop by completed orders rather than by views.

Price bands that apply to everyone are in our how much feet pics sell for note. A male label does not invent a separate rate card.

The ranking site's price pass is how much feet pics sell for. Use it to set a test price, then move it when buyers actually return.

Who the buyers are

No platform publishes a buyer census for male feet, so any pie chart of who pays is fiction. The evidence you can check is the Male category and the gender filter, which exist because some buyers use them.

Themes worth testing are soles, socks, sneakers and barefoot sets. Keep the ones that produce paid orders, and drop the ones that only produce views.

Foot modeling for a brand is a different labour market. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics listed a median of $23.30 an hour for models in May 2025, did not split out foot models or men, and left self-employed workers out of that wage.

Most models in that handbook work part time. The figure tells you nothing about a man selling files to individual buyers, so do not quote it as an expected hourly rate for this work.

Verdict

Guys can sell, the fees match everyone else's, and the demand is real enough to have a category. The income is not a published statistic, so a fixed monthly promise is the line to ignore.

Test a few themes, keep your name off the files, and count money that arrives. Adults only, and a slow first season is a result, not a personal verdict.

FAQ

Can men sell feet pics?

Yes, on FeetFinder, if you are 18 or older and you pass the ID check. Men pay the same fees as everyone else and keep 85 percent on Basic or 90 percent on Premium.

How much can a guy make?

No platform publishes a reliable male-only figure, so a fixed monthly claim is a guess. Plan for slow early months and judge the work by completed sales.

Do men earn less than women?

There is no published comparison. Earnings follow the niche, the files and the promotion, while the fee schedule stays the same.

Do male sellers have to show their face?

No, you can post feet-only files under a username while the ID stays private. FeetFinder does say a full body and face can improve the chance of sales.

Is the model day-rate the same job?

No, the Bureau of Labor Statistics median of $23.30 an hour in May 2025 describes employed models, not self-employed sellers of feet files. It is not an expected rate for this work.

Where should a guy with no followers start?

A feet marketplace with a Male category does the discovery a blank social account will not. Bring your own audience only if you already have one.
